nutshell.headline: 9 new failures — mostly QA Feign read-timeouts (infra), plus a Communication backend 500 and two assertion/validation fails.
nutshell.causeText: 6 of 9 new failures are QA Feign read-timeouts (infra); the rest are a Communication backend 500 (scheduler ResourceNotFoundException from dk-project-communication-rest) and two Quota/Communication assertion fails, one of which plausibly maps to test-module commit NXS-14256 (gergely.gimesi).
nutshell.investigation: Read the real messages: 6× 'Read timed out' = infra, the Communication fails are a backend 500 and a cancel-state assertion, and the Quota fail is a negative test no longer throwing.
bullets: 6× Feign 'Read timed out' (Project ×4, QuotaGroup ×2) — QA infra, not a code regression
3 non-infra new fails: Communication 500 (scheduler), Communication cancel-state assertion, Quota negative-validation (plausibly NXS-14256 / gergely.gimesi)

detail.investigation: 9 of 11 unmuted failures are new vs prior build #3.0.2742 (5 fails); 6 are Feign 'Read timed out' against QA (Project fullProjectSetup ×4, QuotaGroup calculateAdhoc ×2), which are infra, not VCS-driven. The 3 non-infra new fails are a Communication 500 (scheduler ResourceNotFoundException from dk-project-communication-rest — a backend/product error, not a TA-module issue), a Communication cancel-state assertion (status CANCELED vs expected SCHEDULED), and a Quota negative-validation that no longer throws, which plausibly maps to test-module commit NXS-14256 (gergely.gimesi, touches SoldQuotaLockUnlockWorkflowTestSteps); the Lookup optionAssembler NPEs are pre-existing (not new).
bullets: 6× client/Feign socket timeout — feign.RetryableException: Read timed out (QA infra; Project ×4, QuotaGroup ×2)
Communication: 1× backend 500 (scheduler ResourceNotFoundException, dk-project-communication-rest) + 1× assertion (cancel leaves status CANCELED, expected SCHEDULED)
Quota: 1× negative-validation no longer throws — plausibly test-module commit NXS-14256 (gergely.gimesi); Lookup optionAssembler NPEs are pre-existing, not new

likelyCauses.comment: Test-module change to sold-quota-lock (send selectionMode and re-spread on lock) plausibly explains the single Quota negative-validation failure; it does NOT explain the 6 infra timeouts or the Communication backend 500.
